thread:
maya (oncall): seeing spike in 5xx and stream resets from us-west3 GPU pools starting ~5m ago
jamie-eng-sre: confirmed. tcp retransmits and asymmetric routes to the provider backbone in the flow logs
sanjay-netops: provider reports BGP session flaps on their edge, some egress prefixes temporarily unreachable
statusbot: :rotating_light: Incident created — us-west3 egress peering degradation (inc I-202803-B)
leo-infra: impacted: inference-gpu-pool-3 (live) + autoscaler control channel inside that AZ
maya (oncall): user-visible: elevated tail latency for long-context requests, intermittent failed streams, batch jobs delayed
ryan-support: getting inbound tickets from three customers requesting ETA and guidance to reduce errors
jamie-eng-sre: short mitigations: 1) divert new sessions to us-west2/central1; 2) progressively drain non-critical batch workloads from pool-3; 3) enable KV sticky to preserve cache for live sessions
sanjay-netops: testing diversion via secondary IX path now — running small flow validation (p95 latency, packet loss)
leo-infra: drain command for ops: `./drain-pool --pool gpu-pool-3 --mode progressive --grace 100s` — will move new sessions off and let short tail sessions finish
maya (oncall): draft statuspage message: "We are investigating an egress peering issue in us-west3 affecting some inference requests. Traffic is being rerouted while we work with the provider to restore stable peering. We estimate 60–90 minutes for remediation; we will post updates every 30 minutes or on significant changes." ok to post?
ryan-support: please add: "Customers may see transient increased latency and errors; exponential backoff and retries are recommended. Account teams have been notified." also flag possible short-term egress billing uptick
jamie-eng-sre: deploying route-policy change to divert 10% initially and validate `kvcache.sticky=true` behavior for in-flight sessions
deploy-bot: Deploy started by jamie-eng-sre: route-policy-rollout v2 -> 3 targets
sanjay-netops: secondary IX test green for microflows, BGP still noisy for some prefixes, will ramp to 30% traffic for further validation
leo-infra: paused autoscaler for pool-3 to avoid scale churn: `kubectl patch cm autoscaler-config --patch '{"spec":{"paused":true}}'` — will restore with conservative thresholds after stabilization
maya (oncall): posting status now
statusbot: Statuspage updated: "Investigating — routing traffic away from us-west3 due to egress peering instability. Mitigation in progress; next update in 30 minutes or on resolution."
ryan-support: notified affected customers and opened tickets; tagging finance for potential +12% egress cost impact if diversion persists
jamie-eng-sre: monitoring token error-rate and stream resets. If BGP not stable in 45m, escalate to full failover of live traffic to us-west2 and scale reserved capacity there
sanjay-netops: now carrying 45% of traffic on secondary IX, no packet loss observed. still seeing flaps on provider edge for a subset of prefixes
leo-infra: ops note: cross-region diversion will increase egress costs and replication traffic; tracking per-customer delta for billing and account teams
maya (oncall): setting checkpoint +45m for decision. if escalate, we'll post an executive update and outreach to SLA contacts
ryan-support: assembling list of impacted customers for proactive outreach and CS handoff
jamie-eng-sre: rolling affinity tweak for high-tail flows: `route.affinity.tail_threshold=2s` to move sessions exceeding 2s to alternative pools
ops-bot: Incident I-202803-B severity set to P1. oncall rotation notified
maya (oncall): keep channel updates concise every 10m. focus on stabilizing peering and minimizing cache churn. will post the +30m customer update
sanjay-netops: working with provider NOC on BGP dampening and route-reflection fix; next check in 10m
leo-infra: once diversion completes, we'll re-enable autoscaler with conservative CPU/GPU scale limits to avoid rapid provisioning costs
jamie-eng-sre: monitoring shows p50 ok, p95 elevated but trending down since diversion started
statusbot: Next scheduled status update added (30m)
ryan-support: prepping final customer advisory for +30m update — will include retry/backoff guidance, temporary billing note, and support contact info
maya (oncall): thanks team. short updates only from here — tag if you need a priority bridge or exec comms.
